title: Gujarat can raise farmer incomes by moving output through a **4-step** pathway from on-farm productivity to value-added market realization
subtitle: This income pathway adds the missing operating lens after market access: income gains depend on improving production, reducing post-harvest loss, strengthening market linkage, and capturing value beyond raw output.

blocks.title: Productivity lift increases the saleable surplus that enters the income chain
blocks.body: Evidence focus: crop yield improvement, input-use efficiency, irrigation-backed stability, and higher marketable output from the same farm base.

blocks.title: Post-harvest handling protects value before produce reaches the market
blocks.body: Evidence focus: grading, storage, drying, aggregation, and lower physical and quality loss between harvest and first sale.

blocks.title: Market linkage improves price realization by connecting farmers to stronger demand channels
blocks.body: Evidence focus: mandi access, buyer diversity, collection networks, logistics reach, and better alignment between produce quality and end-market demand.

blocks.title: Value addition captures more of the consumer rupee than raw-produce sales alone
blocks.body: Evidence focus: processing, packaging, branding, product differentiation, and local enterprise models that retain more value within the farm economy.
